result.summary: The page is largely well-composed, but there is a notable state/content mismatch: the 'Pizza' category chip is selected while the listings below show poke, burgers and ramen. There are also small inconsistencies in the favorite-button treatment and low-contrast placeholder text.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is shown in the active/selected state, yet the content below is unfiltered: 'Fastest near you' shows Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria, and 'Popular right now' leads with Tokumaru Ramen Bar. Only the second popular card is pizza-related, so the selected filter appears not to be applied to the rendered results.
issues.suggestion: Either render the results filtered by the selected category (pizza-only restaurants/dishes) or reset the chip selection to 'All' so the visual state matches the content being displayed.

issues.description: Inconsistent favorite (heart) button styling between cards: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart sits directly on the image with no circular scrim, while the pizza card below uses a dark translucent circular background. On lighter image areas the un-backed icon would be hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same dark translucent circular backdrop (or a consistent shadow/scrim) to the heart button on every restaurant card for uniform appearance and reliable contrast.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is very light gray on a light gray fill, giving a low contrast ratio that is difficult to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (aim for at least 4.5:1 against the field background) or lighten the field fill to increase contrast.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards also show rating, ETA and cuisine. The missing rating/cuisine metadata makes the two rows feel inconsistent and gives users less information to compare options.
issues.suggestion: Add a compact rating and/or cuisine tag to the 'Fastest near you' cards, or intentionally document the reduced metadata design so both rows feel deliberate.
